description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 ne Astir.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 106.02 m2, nga te cilat 90.57 m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se brendeshme dhe 15.45 m2 jane pjese e siperfaqes se perbashket.
Organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje bashke me kendin e gatimit dhe te ngrenies, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 2 ballkone.
Apartamenti eshte pjese e nje pallati te ri ne ndertim, i cili perfundon ne dhjetor te vitit 2026.
description_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale in Astir. The apartment has a total surface of 106.02 m2, of which 90.57 m2 are part of the internal surface and 15.45 m2 are part of the common surface. It is organized in a living room with a kitchen and dining area, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies. The apartment is part of a new building under construction, which will be completed in December 2026.
